name: zerodha-equity-delivery-sell-d1-regression
describes: The D1 defect, frozen. The superseded implementation applied GST to a merged government-charges bucket that included securities transaction tax, which is not a taxable service. On this trade it billed ₹21.00 of GST against a correct ₹3.00 — an overcharge of ₹18.00 on a single ₹1,00,000 sale. If GST is ever computed over STT again, this fixture fails with a self-explanatory diff.

supersededImplementation.note: Base wrongly included STT at ₹100.00. The correct base is ₹16.67. The tech spec quotes ₹17.45 for this defect; that figure came from a different set of assumed rates, and the arithmetic here follows the placeholder card actually shipped.
